scope: 71 academic workflow equipment records with Purdue-documented installations reviewed first
method: Compare institution, manufacturer and established seller pages with the catalog model or documented installation.
Keep public Purdue facility references distinct from institutional inventory. Remote photo references retain source attribution.
Label shared model family photos and configured seller offers. A seller price reflects the specified condition, not MSRP.
Retain the source currency and amount. Convert public display values to USD using the catalog's dated exchange rates.
Exclude access fees, auction bids, accessories, sold-out and model-mismatched offers from new catalog purchase price evidence.
